headline: [Rare Shutdown!] US Grounds Flights Nationwide for [4+ Hours]
sub: Air traffic communication failure halts departures
caption:
✈️ Rare Shutdown: US Grounds Flights Nationwide for 4+ Hours

The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) stopped flights from taking off at all US airports on Friday afternoon, after a communication problem hit air traffic control centres across the country. Departures were halted for more than four hours before the FAA lifted the order late Friday.

🔹 The FAA said the ground stop was ordered "for reasons of safety" after "communication issues" at multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers. Technicians are still looking into the cause.
🔹 By Friday evening, FlightAware showed more than 1,900 flights cancelled and over 10,000 delayed in the US. Delays are expected to continue.
🔹 Officials said there was no sign of a "nefarious" act. It was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023.

💬 Have you ever been stuck at an airport because of a big delay? 👇

Sources: CBS News, ABC News, Al Jazeera, FAA

#GlobalEye #FAA #Flights #USA #AirTravel #WorldNews
photo_needed: A busy US airport departures board showing many delayed/cancelled flights, or planes parked at a US airport gate (no person needed). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Health Setback!] US Reportedly Loses Measles-Free Status After [26 Years]
sub: Measles kept spreading for over a year
caption:
🦠 Health Setback: US Reportedly Loses Measles-Free Status After 26 Years

The United States has lost its "measles eliminated" status, which it held since 2000, according to reports by Reuters and CNN on Friday. Reuters, citing the Wall Street Journal, said the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) took the step because measles kept spreading in the US for more than a year.

🔹 The CDC had counted 5,182 confirmed measles cases in 2026 as of Thursday, from 45 states, New York City and Washington, D.C. That is more than double the 2,289 cases in all of 2025.
🔹 State health officials have reported at least 10 measles-related deaths in the US this year, after two more were reported in Pennsylvania and Wisconsin.
🔹 PAHO and the US health department had not commented publicly when the reports came out. Experts say two doses of the measles vaccine give about 97% protection.

💬 Do you think more people should get vaccinated against measles? 👇

Sources: Reuters, CNN, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #Measles #PublicHealth #USA #Vaccines #WorldNews
photo_needed: A measles vaccine vial and syringe (MMR vaccine), or a doctor/nurse giving a vaccine shot to a child's arm (face not needed). A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Post-Messi Era Begins!] Uruguay Beat Argentina [2-1] at La Bombonera
sub: First Argentina match since Messi retired
caption:
⚽ Post-Messi Era Begins: Uruguay Beat Argentina 2-1 at La Bombonera

Uruguay beat Argentina 2-1 in a friendly at La Bombonera in Buenos Aires on Friday night. It was Argentina's first match since Lionel Messi retired from international football in early October.

🔹 Uruguay scored twice early in the second half: a Leonardo Balerdi own goal (48') and a goal by Maxi Araújo (53'). Julián Álvarez pulled one back for Argentina in the 73rd minute.
🔹 Argentina left the No. 10 shirt unassigned. Coach Lionel Scaloni said: "We have to rebuild without Leo Messi, and we have the talent to bounce back from this loss."
🔹 Messi ended his Argentina career with 125 goals in 207 games. Argentina play Costa Rica in Córdoba on Tuesday.

💬 Who should wear Argentina's No. 10 shirt next? 👇

Sources: ESPN, AP

#GlobalEye #Argentina #Uruguay #Messi #Football #Scaloni
photo_needed: Argentina vs Uruguay match at La Bombonera (players in action, landscape), or Uruguay players celebrating. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Hormuz Blasts!] Iran Says [3 Oil Tankers] Hit Mines and Caught Fire
sub: Iran says ships used banned routes
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Iran Says 3 Oil Tankers Hit Mines and Caught Fire in Hormuz

Iran's navy and Revolutionary Guards said on Saturday that three oil tankers hit naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz and caught fire. Iran says the ships had switched off their tracking systems and were using routes it does not allow.

🔹 Iran said two of the tankers were hit in the south of the strait, one of them a supertanker. A third was hit east of the strait. The ships' names and any casualties were not given, and there is no independent confirmation yet.
🔹 The UN told the Security Council on Friday that at least 25 seafarers have been killed in and around Hormuz since the war began in February.
🔹 Shipping through Hormuz is about 65% below pre-war levels, the UK's maritime agency (UKMTO) says. The US military says it has cleared the main routes of mines.

💬 How do you think this will affect oil prices? 👇

Sources: AFP, Al Jazeera, Middle East Eye

#GlobalEye #Hormuz #Iran #OilTankers #Shipping #WorldNews
photo_needed: Oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz (ideally a tanker on fire or with smoke), or a wide shot of tankers in the strait. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.
